items.text: Nearly all of its members cosponsored from its introduction a bill giving people brought to the country as children, and holders of temporary protection from removal, permanent residence and a path to citizenship. An independent estimate of an identical earlier version put those potentially eligible at up to about 4.4 million people, about 1.3 percent of the population.
Voted as a group to oppose any spending bill funding the immigration enforcement agencies until their enforcement practices changed substantially.
